The '''Besberra arena''' was a [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiatorial]] arena on [[Besberra]],<ref name="Codex" /> an astronomical object in the [[Besberra system/Legends|Besberra system]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' &mdash; based on corresponding information for the [[Besberra system/Legends|Besberra system]]</ref> Sometime before [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> a [[Houk/Legends|Houk]] named [[Torog]] fought for five straight [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] in the arena, defeating waves of opponents and wild animals before dropping [[Death/Legends|dead]]. An autopsy of the Houk revealed that he had been fighting for four hours with a broken neck, earning Torog posthumous fame.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Besberra arena was mentioned in the Codex entry for the Houk [[Species/Legends|species]] in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Codex" />
